asks: What kind are the other actions the design names?
answer: Granting: bring a computer back from the bin; copy files from a fork into its parent; grant an extension the tool that forwards alerts and asks (`forwarding-tool`). A copy into the parent first saves the parent's own versions of the files it replaces, so it erases nothing. Destructive: purge files, put back paths, remove a checkpoint, empty the bin, remove paths from a checkpoint that holds them, remove content from the store at its size limit. Leaving paths out of the checkpoints still to come erases nothing when it is set; its kind is asked apart.
